entry.summary: High AI accuracy in acoustics is often an illusion caused by data leakage during testing. Honest validation crushes it severalfold, but even then, algorithms accurately measure loudness and decay time, and most importantly, masterfully reconstruct the sound field between sensors.

This improves forecast accuracy while keeping the model interpretable.
